verses.text: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.

segments.text: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.

verses.text: Hear, O heavens, and give ear, O earth; for Jehovah hath spoken: I have nourished and brought up children, and they have rebelled against me.

segments.text: Hear, O heavens, and give ear, O earth; for Jehovah hath spoken: I have nourished and brought up children, and they have rebelled against me.

verses.text: The ox knoweth his owner, and the ass his master’s crib; but Israel doth not know, my people doth not consider.

segments.text: The ox knoweth his owner, and the ass his master’s crib;
but

verses.text: Ah sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity, a seed of evil-doers, children that deal corruptly! they have forsaken Jehovah, they have despised the Holy One of Israel, they are estranged and gone backward.

segments.text: Ah sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity, a seed of evil-doers, children that deal corruptly! they have forsaken Jehovah, they have despised the Holy One of Israel, they are estranged
and gone
backward.

verses.text: Why will ye be still stricken, that ye revolt more and more? the whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.

segments.text: Why will ye be still stricken, that ye revolt more and more? the whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.

verses.text: From the sole of the foot even unto the head there is no soundness in it; but wounds, and bruises, and fresh stripes: they have not been closed, neither bound up, neither mollified with oil.

segments.text: From the sole of the foot even unto the head there is no soundness in it;
but

verses.text: Your country is desolate; your cities are burned with fire; your land, strangers devour it in your presence, and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.

segments.text: Your country is desolate; your cities are burned with fire; your land, strangers devour it in your presence, and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.

verses.text: And the daughter of Zion is left as a booth in a vineyard, as a lodge in a garden of cucumbers, as a besieged city.

segments.text: And the daughter of Zion is left as a booth in a vineyard, as a lodge in a garden of cucumbers, as a besieged city.

verses.text: Except Jehovah of hosts had left unto us a very small remnant, we should have been as Sodom, we should have been like unto Gomorrah.

segments.text: Except Jehovah of hosts had left unto us a very small remnant, we should have been as Sodom, we should have been like unto Gomorrah.

verses.text: Hear the word of Jehovah, ye rulers of Sodom; give ear unto the law of our God, ye people of Gomorrah.

segments.text: Hear the word of Jehovah, ye rulers of Sodom; give ear unto the law of our God, ye people of Gomorrah.

verses.text: What unto me is the multitude of your sacrifices? saith Jehovah: I have had enough of the burnt-offerings of rams, and the fat of fed beasts; and I delight not in the blood of bullocks, or of lambs, or of he-goats.

segments.text: What unto me is the multitude of your sacrifices? saith Jehovah: I have had enough of the burnt-offerings of rams, and the fat of fed beasts; and I delight not in the blood of bullocks, or of lambs, or of he-goats.

verses.text: When ye come to appear before me, who hath required this at your hand, to trample my courts?

segments.text: When ye come to appear before me, who hath required this at your hand, to trample my courts?

verses.text: Bring no more vain oblations; incense is an abomination unto me; new moon and sabbath, the calling of assemblies,—I cannot away with iniquity and the solemn meeting.

segments.text: Bring no more vain oblations; incense is an abomination unto me; new moon and sabbath, the calling of assemblies,—I cannot away with iniquity and the solemn meeting.

verses.text: Your new moons and your appointed feasts my soul hateth; they are a trouble unto me; I am weary of bearing them.

segments.text: Your new moons and your appointed feasts my soul hateth; they are a trouble unto me; I am weary of bearing them.

verses.text: And when ye spread forth your hands, I will hide mine eyes from you; yea, when ye make many prayers, I will not hear: your hands are full of blood.

segments.text: And when ye spread forth your hands, I will hide mine eyes from you; yea, when ye make many prayers, I will not hear: your hands are full of blood.

verses.text: Wash you, make you clean; put away the evil of your doings from before mine eyes; cease to do evil;

segments.text: Wash you, make you clean; put away the evil of your doings from before mine eyes; cease to do evil;

verses.text: learn to do well; seek justice, relieve the oppressed, judge the fatherless, plead for the widow.

segments.text: learn to do well; seek justice, relieve the oppressed, judge the fatherless, plead for the widow.

verses.text: Come now, and let us reason together, saith Jehovah: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.

segments.text: Come now, and let us reason together, saith Jehovah: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.

verses.text: If ye be willing and obedient, ye shall eat the good of the land:

segments.text: If ye be willing and obedient, ye shall eat the good of the land:

verses.text: but if ye refuse and rebel, ye shall be devoured with the sword; for the mouth of Jehovah hath spoken it.

segments.text: but if ye refuse and rebel, ye shall be devoured with the sword; for the mouth of Jehovah hath spoken it.

verses.text: How is the faithful city become a harlot! she that was full of justice! righteousness lodged in her, but now murderers.

segments.text: How is the faithful city become a harlot! she that was full of justice! righteousness lodged in her, but now murderers.

verses.text: Thy silver is become dross, thy wine mixed with water.

segments.text: Thy silver is become dross, thy wine mixed with water.

verses.text: Thy princes are rebellious, and companions of thieves; every one loveth bribes, and followeth after rewards: they judge not the fatherless, neither doth the cause of the widow come unto them.

segments.text: Thy princes are rebellious, and companions of thieves; every one loveth bribes, and followeth after rewards: they judge not the fatherless, neither doth the cause of the widow come unto them.

verses.text: Therefore saith the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, the Mighty One of Israel, Ah, I will ease me of mine adversaries, and avenge me of mine enemies;

segments.text: Therefore saith the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, the Mighty One of Israel, Ah, I will ease me of mine adversaries, and avenge me of mine enemies;

verses.text: and I will turn my hand upon thee, and thoroughly purge away thy dross, and will take away all thy tin;

segments.text: and I will turn my hand upon thee, and thoroughly purge away thy dross, and will take away all thy tin;

verses.text: and I will restore thy judges as at the first, and thy counsellors as at the beginning: afterward thou shalt be called The city of righteousness, a faithful town.

segments.text: and I will restore thy judges as at the first, and thy counsellors as at the beginning: afterward thou shalt be called The city of righteousness, a faithful town.

verses.text: Zion shall be redeemed with justice, and her converts with righteousness.

segments.text: Zion shall be redeemed with justice, and her converts with righteousness.

verses.text: But the destruction of transgressors and sinners shall be together, and they that forsake Jehovah shall be consumed.

segments.text: But the destruction of transgressors and sinners shall be together, and they that forsake Jehovah shall be consumed.

verses.text: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which ye have desired, and ye shall be confounded for the gardens that ye have chosen.

segments.text: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which ye have desired, and ye shall be confounded for the gardens that ye have chosen.

verses.text: For ye shall be as an oak whose leaf fadeth, and as a garden that hath no water.

segments.text: For ye shall be as an oak whose leaf fadeth, and as a garden that hath no water.

verses.text: And the strong shall be as tow, and his work as a spark; and they shall both burn together, and none shall quench them.

segments.text: And the strong shall be as tow, and his work as a spark; and they shall both burn together, and none shall quench them.
